blocks.title: Successive IE jump
blocks.problem: A main-group atom has successive ionization energies 600, 1800, 2700, and 11,600 kJ/mol. How many valence electrons are suggested?

steps.title: Find the jump
steps.md: The largest rise is between IE₃ and IE₄.
steps.why: The fourth electron is much harder to remove.

steps.title: Interpret
steps.md: The first three removals depleted the valence shell.
steps.why: The fourth removal reaches the core.

blocks.title: Recall from memory
cards: Across a main-group period, what generally happens to radius?
It decreases as effective nuclear charge rises.
Why is IE₁ of O below N?
O has a paired 2p electron that is easier to remove.
